stories.title: How ChatGPT and Lane Kiffin could have gotten LSU kicked out of the SEC
stories.summary: It's a twisted tale of grandstanding politicians, colorful characters and college football's most polarizing figure.

stories.title: DC Belichick resigns as UNC investigation finds disregard for conduct
stories.summary: North Carolina DC Steve Belichick has resigned as the university's probe into the football program's culture and climate found "isolated" disregard for standards of conduct.

stories.title: Teen Sullivan in USMNT squad, Pulisic left out
stories.summary: Philadelphia Union phenom Cavan Sullivan, 16, headlines the 28-player roster named by U.S. men's national team manager Mauricio Pochettino for the upcoming FIFA international window.

stories.title: Kyrie offers to pay Al-Shaair's fine for tribute to slain Palestinian girl
stories.summary: Kyrie Irving offered to pay Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair's $11,941 fine for having the name of a Palestinian girl killed in Gaza in 2024 written on his eye black during a game.

stories.title: LSU QB Leavitt unexpectedly listed as doubtful for Ole Miss rivalry game
stories.summary: In a surprising turn of events, LSU listed starting quarterback Sam Leavitt as doubtful for Saturday. The exact nature of his injury is unclear.
